title: Your learning plan
introduction: Turn one course lesson into a small, practical next step.

sections.title: 1. Choose one goal
sections.body: Write one thing you want to understand after this lesson.

sections.title: 2. Try a small example
sections.body: Put the idea into practice. Keep your first example simple.

sections.title: 3. Record what happened
sections.body: Note what worked, what surprised you and one question to ask.

sections.title: 4. Review and repeat
sections.body: Explain the idea in your own words, then choose your next step.
